summary: Full e2e testing for Digital Cards IA Cliente persistence feature. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed (list+seed, idempotent seed, create valid/invalid/duplicate, update+GET+delete verification, public GET by slug, 404 unknown slug). Frontend: Admin CRUD flow works end-to-end - create client via form (Publicado), row appears with 'Abrir mini site' + 'Copiar link', edit persists, delete confirmation dialog + confirm removes client, invalid slug shows PT-BR toast. Public /c/studio-exemplo renders CardTemplate with all 8 buttons (WhatsApp, Localização, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Website, Avaliar no Google, Ligar agora) plus endereço, horário, telefone. /c/unknown-slug shows 'Página não encontrada' state.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'); consider FastAPI lifespan handlers for future-proofing.
Admin.jsx (~543 lines) is approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting NewClientView into its own module as more fields/uploads are added.
Slug validation is duplicated between frontend SLUG_REGEX and backend SLUG_REGEX — acceptable but keep them in sync when rules change.
seed_data_creation: None additional; seed 'studio-exemplo' auto-created by backend startup. All test clients created during e2e were cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Cliente CRUD + public endpoint stable. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_clientes.py for regression. Admin UI selectors use data-testid pattern: client-row-<slug>, client-edit-<slug>, client-delete-<slug>, client-open-<slug>, client-copy-<slug>, delete-confirm-dialog, delete-confirm-button, admin-save-client-button, field-*.
